summary: This paper introduces the normalized Schatten-q Crouzeix constant Psi_q(A) and investigates its behavior across dimensions and Schatten exponents. The author establishes universal linear/disk majorization linked to Clifford Cl2 parity staircases, proves universal Ky Fan dominance of the odd Riemann conformal map on M2(C), discovers an exact Hilbert-Schmidt critical phase transition at qc=2 with a subcritical explosion of interior elliptical extremizers, and derives a dimension-independent double-layer POVM trace bound. All core algebraic and polynomial inequalities are formally verified in Lean 4.36.0 with zero sorries.
strengths: Pioneering formulation and comprehensive analysis of normalized Schatten-q Crouzeix constants across all exponents q in [1, infinity].
Discovery of the exact Hilbert-Schmidt critical phase transition at qc=2, contrasting nilpotent disk extremality with subcritical interior elliptical maximizers.
Rigorous formal verification in Lean 4.36.0 with zero sorries, ensuring absolute mathematical correctness of algebraic and polynomial cores.
Elegant synthesis of conformal mapping (elliptic functions, Jacobi theta identities) and double-layer potential theory.
weaknesses: The generalized Schatten-q Crouzeix conjecture for odd dimensions remains open, relying on numerical verification rather than full analytical proof.
Highly specialized operator theory focus may have narrower immediate impact outside functional analysis and mathematical physics.
strong_novelty_candidates: Universal linear and disk majorization theorem characterizing even-dimensional equality via Clifford algebra Cl2 unitary representations.
Exact M2(C) conformal Riemann map dominance and explicit closed-form evaluation via Jacobi theta functions.
Proof of the exact Hilbert-Schmidt critical phase transition at qc=2 and the associated critical scaling divergence law.
